content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to connect [product_name] with ULCT 900/108 E Light Curtains? Can [product_name] handle it in the same way as a standard sensor?
[product_name] is not certified for safety-related use.
I understand that, but my intention is not to use the curtain for safety purposes. I just want to count items falling from the assembly line into the container.
If you are not using safety functions, refer to this diagram.
Can you specify which of the seven wires serves as the signal wire that should be connected to the digital input?
Are you not an electrician? Is this diagram difficult for you to understand?
Apologies, I am still learning and I missed some details on the diagram.

Please review the manual you uploaded in your initial post. On page 7, you’ll find various operation modes and instructions on how to change them permanently. Switch to "- -" mode (no EDM / no restart interlock). Then you'll need only three wires: Pin 2 (brown) +Ub: connect to DC24V, same as [product_name] supply Pin 7 (blue) -Ub: connect to M of [product_name] or power supply unit Pin 5 (grey) OSSD1: connect to any input I1 ... I8 on [product_name] Ensure you are using a [product_name] supplied with DC24V for this setup. If you don't change the operation mode, connect DC24V to Pin 2, Pin 1, and Pin 4. Pin 6 is not required for inputs. Regards, [user_name]
Thank you for your assistance. My current objective is to understand how these sensors work and to learn how to program them. I haven't posted such questions here before.

There are some uncertainties about wiring and configurations, indicating documentation gaps and a need for clear instructional support, especially for beginners handling unusual sensor setups.
